loops.prayer:
I just want to know where I'm going when I disappear. 
I want to know where my voice travels when it is silenced. 
I want to dive into the space my mind occupies when it dissociates.
I want to understand how my body is still here. How it manages to survive while everything else is forced elsewhere. 

I just want to know where i'm going when I disappear. Maybe it is somewhere holy. 
Maybe it is somewhere kind and. 
Maybe it is somewhere uplifting 
Maybe it is somewhere open 
Maybe it is somewhere loving
Maybe it is somewhere abundant
Maybe it is somewhere nourishing. 
Maybe it is somewhere I am free. 

Maybe it is Black Liberated Reality.
loops.leadingQuestion: What is a Black Liberated reality to you?

loops.prayer:
I've lived my entire life at the end of the world.
In between life and death.
In between day in night
In between this world and the next in between. 

Pushed to the edge of my consciousness into seemingly another reality. Each time I've been forced back here. If I am the portals keeper, then why do I feel trapped?

For so long I have wanted to transition, to escape. To rest. To dive into a place I just don’t know can even manifest into my reality as it is now.

I've never loved this body 
I've always hated this body 
And I've punished this body just like the world taught me to. I've abandoned this body. 
I've hurt this body
And I've mistreated this body. 

However, 
I want to take this moment to thank my body for not giving up on me. Fooor being the home I always needed. That I always manage to come back to. 

For the first time in life I want to live. I want to learn how to live. I want to know my body. Experience my body. Move in my body. I want one more chance to try. 

Because the land has been calling me. 
The trees, the grass, and the wildlife of all forms have been calling me. 
The water has been calling me. 
The oceans, the ponds, the rivers, the lakes and the swamps too have been calling me.
My ancestors have been calling me. My nana, My grandaddy, My father, My auntie, My little cousin, and My uncle Slick have been calling me from the altar I haven’t sat at in a month, and have felt too ashamed to admit aloud until now.

In New York, she became the eldest sister of 7 children in the midst of the Great Depression. All siblings were separated and placed in different foster homes until later they found their way back to each other.  The children of the Bloom. Young Black children drifting away - yet finding their way back home.

loops.prayer:
Spirit has been calling me. And for too long I have been ignoring the call, searching for all the ways to get where I say I am headed without dealing with what is right in front of me. 

Spirit has been calling me, and today I answered the call. My body has finally rejected all forms of conformity requiring me to look the other way. There was never a moment in time where my perceived stability actually kept me safe, and yesterday I was reminded of this reality. 

Today, I finally cleaned my altar and sat there in tears. My ancestors sat with me as a witness without judgement, or anger listening to me as I say my prayer. 


Phytoplankton take their name from - phyto - plant / plankton -  drifters. They have been on the planet for more than 3 billion years, and have witnessed the earth through its various stages. Today there are more than 20,000 species drifting atop the earth’s waters in different oceanic and fresh water habitats. Through photosynthesis they absorb sunlight and transform it into 50-80% of the earth’s oxygen that we breathe daily. 

Thank you.
For holding me when I had no strength.
For keeping me alive
When I was such a young child
Raised in the trenches of anti-Blackness.
Absorbing it in my bones
And wreaking of inferiority.
You reminded me why I am here today.
To release that pain.
To share in that healing.
To find my way back to you.
loops.leadingQuestion: What are you reestablishing your connection to?

loops.prayer:
My nana was my first contact with The Mother of the Sun. The great cosmic mother who gave birth to the sun. It was through her love, that even my darkest hour became one of courage and devotion. We were at one point in time the oldest and youngest of our family. The moment where space and time collapsed. I remember getting lost and going on adventures together. I also remember sobbing in her arms when the cruelty of the world was too heavy to bear.
My nana has been calling me. Her presence now sits on my altar. The portal where she witnesses,  encourages me to never give up. 
For We must face our wounds as they pop up in our bodies when we are triggered. When it makes the hairs on our backs raise up, asking us "are you ready to truly heal me yet. Or will you allow me to lay dormant again?" To truly end the cycle of harmful trauma we must be willing to dive deep into it, and trust that our guides are there waiting for us on the other side.
Transformation can be a painful experience. I know this as a lifelong learner. I know this as a lifelong worker. When we first engage in any new thing we are bound to fail and we should welcome that failure like an old friend that sits down with us and asks us "how are you?" In a way that is truly and patiently waiting to listen to you bear your soul. That's what true humility is. It's not a lack of confidence to admit to suck at something at first, confidence is when you work through the initial hump and commit to yourself and say "I will never give up on me." 
When we take off the training wheels we are bound to fall and scrape our knees, but our guides are there waiting patiently like the proud parents some of us may have never had. But even when those parents haven't materialized how society says they must. Know you are loved. The portal  asks us to consider this journey. 
To consider our pain, and the vices we struggle with to conceal them. It asks us to allow those wounds to show themselves to confront them, and only then can we ask, "what is a Black Liberated Reality?
Through my journey on this earth the dark mother has come to me through many manifestations and iterations. Continuously offering me birth, death and renewals. I now often wonder about the kind of world that must be restored for Black children - for all children to want to live and to choose life.
loops.leadingQuestion: Who must we transform into  to become better guides and caretakers?

loops.prayer:
For I am the child of many mothers 
and I am the mother of children lost by the wayside.
The Mother of the Sun gives birth to Children of the Bloom. 
The Mother oif the Sea gives birth to Children of the Bloom.
The Mother of the Air gives birth to Children of the Bloom. 
The Mother of the Earth gives birth to Children of the Bloom
Let us remember these children, hold them close to us, cover them, 
and relieve them from the version of the world that has no issue in 
their demise. 
Let us be returned to our mothers. And give us back our children.
Algal blooms are massive events where phytoplankton accumulate in high numbers due to an overabundance of nutrients : nitrogen and phosphorus. Some are benign and essential to the oceans’ atmosphere and some harmful, resulting in massive fish kills and oxygen depletion. 
While both algal bloom states have occurred on the planet for millennia, it's important to remember that the recent growth in harmful algal blooms is directly connected to water pollution. 

Algal blooms can also be imagined as a distributed network. Each individual phytoplankton acts as a node in a larger network creating massive change in the ocean and earth’s atmosphere.
In this light, the harmful algal bloom can be seen as the metaphor for our aching network we must tend to with one another and the natural world. For we too carry within us a distributed network, capable of massive change. 
For too long we have been stripped of our individual and collective power.
For too long we have been coerced and manipulated into giving our individual and collective power away to systems and ways of life whose extraction and exploitation play a role in our collective downfall. Our once symbiotic relationship to nature has turned to one dependent on us giving up our node to the centralized beast that is destroying us.
loops.leadingQuestion: What is your relationship to power?

loops.prayer:
If love is courage. If love is without fear. If love is action (in care and intention). Then how do we immerse ourselves in love - the very thing that forces us outside of our everyday lives filled with fear. Shame, complicity? The things that keep us alive in our bodies, even if not in our souls. 
How do we immerse ourselves in a love that forces us to understand our current ways of life are not enough
A love that forces us to jump into the unknown 
A love that forces us to trust the the unknown
That forces us to speak up, look death in the face and say I see you and I still choose love. Because I am no longer afraid. I choose love.
May we unveil the network where we all are in relation with earth in sacred and caring ways. 
May we restore our agency to empower ourselves and others. 
May we step into
A world that is sustainable.
A world that graces children with life. With space to play. To grow. To learn. To love. To heal. To see. That doesn't murder them. That doesn’t fight to limit their dreams. 
A world that truly loves all people, and does not just say it without accountability.
loops.leadingQuestion: How will you hold yourself accountable to a liberated world?

loops.prayer:
Let us step into Blackness. BLACKNESS  as invisible, transparent, clear, unknown,  unseen, untouchable 

Blackness as expansive, Blackness as the night sky, Blackness as the universe. Blackness as unbound by colonial markers such as time, gender, race, sexuality

Blackness as is.

A Black Liberated Reality is a Liberated Reality for all. Truly, 
Open your heart and allow love to flow through you. Allow it to move you to act. Allow it to move you to grow. To remove any delusions that tell you to do otherwise

From my wounds opened a portal. Maybe my life's purpose is not to step through just yet, but to build it. And  to somehow turn it outwards into our reality now not as a bandage or as some romantic dream that will never be capable of existing. - But as a love grounded in reality, in truth, and in solidarity.  And maybe if you all agree, we can build it together.

The Water is calling us
The earth is calling us
The cosmos are calling us

Spirit is calling us. 
Our siblings are calling us.
Our parents, cousins, and friends are calling us. 
Our ancestors are calling us. 
Our descendents are calling us. 

Calling us to wake up to listen and to respond.
I pray we answer.

Raise your hands towards the rupture.
Breathe in. Bring your hands together.
Drift among the phytoplankton.
Breathe out. Move your hands apart.
Rise into the earth’s atmosphere.
Inhale. Move closer.
Exhale. Move outward.
Consider what we have the power to transform.
Stay as long as you need.
